title: 24-hour PK concentration–time profiles and AUC comparison
what: Liposomal_IV delivers 2.10x the 24h AUC of IR_tablet (1614 vs 769 ng·h/mL, n = 8/arm)

reader_questions.question: How much higher is Liposomal_IV's 24-hour AUC than IR_tablet?
How is inter-subject variability shown?
reader_questions.expected: Mean ± 95% CI (or SD) across n = 8 subjects per formulation.

reader_questions.question: How does ER_capsule behave compared to IR_tablet?
reader_questions.expected: ER_capsule lowers the early Cmax peak while maintaining higher trough levels through 12–24 h.
